title: RNA Extraction with Spin Columns from Yeast Cells
author: Jamie Auxillos

steps.title: Prepare Yeast Single Colonies
steps.instruction: Streak yeast from glycerol stocks onto appropriate solid media petri dishes and grow for 48 hours at 30 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Pre-culture Plate
steps.instruction: Set up a 24-well culture plate for strain pre-culture, including media-only negative control wells.

substeps.instruction: Plan the plate layout by subdividing strains into groups of 6.
Transfer 1 mL of sterile media to each well of a sterile 24 (deep) well plate (Star lab cat no. E2824-0000) using a pipette controller.

steps.title: Inoculate and Grow Pre-cultures
steps.instruction: Inoculate the pre-culture plate and grow overnight.

substeps.instruction: Using sterile P20 tips, inoculate each well with a single colony of the appropriate strain, using a new tip for each strain.
Seal the plate with a gas permeable seal (Thermo cat #AB0718).
Incubate in a shaking incubator at 30 °C and 200 rpm overnight (16-20 hours).

steps.title: Determine Pre-culture OD600
steps.instruction: Measure the optical density of the overnight cultures.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of overnight culture to a cuvette and add 900 µL of media (1:10 dilution).
Measure OD600 using a spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Prepare Main Culture Plate
steps.instruction: Set up a 12-column deep well plate for the main culture, including media-only wells.

substeps.instruction: Plan the layout by subdividing strains into groups of 12.
Dispense 7 mL of media into each well of sterile 12 column deep well plates (4titude cat #PCR0244) using an Eppendorf pipette controller (cat #4430000018).

steps.title: Inoculate and Grow Main Cultures
steps.instruction: Inoculate the main culture to a starting OD600 of 0.2 and grow to target density.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the volume of overnight culture needed to reach a starting OD600 of 0.2 in 8 mL total volume.
Transfer the calculated volume into the respective wells, changing tips for each strain/biorep.
Seal with a gas permeable seal and grow in a shaking incubator at 30 °C and 90 rpm until OD600 reaches 0.5 - 0.7 (approximately 3.5 - 4 hours).
Verify starting ODs (0.15 - 0.2) by measuring 1 mL of the diluted culture via spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Harvest and Pellet Cells
steps.instruction: Pellet the yeast cells once the target OD600 is reached.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the 12 column deep well plate at 3000 x g for 3 minutes.
Remove media from each well using an aspirator, changing tips for each well and avoiding the pellet. Do not decant.

steps.title: Prepare Bead Beating Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare screw cap tubes with zirconia beads for mechanical lysis.

substeps.instruction: Take screw cap tubes (Sarstedt cat #12705493).
Measure zirconia beads (BioSpec #11079105z) using a PCR tube (fill the PCR tube entirely) and add beads to the screw cap tubes.
Label each tube.

steps.title: Lysis and Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellets and perform mechanical lysis using a PreCellys Evolution.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in the 12 column deep well plate with 400 µL of RNA binding buffer (Zymo cat no. R1013-2) and transfer to the screw cap tubes containing zirconia beads; keep on ice.
Transfer tubes to the PreCellys Evolution and run the EW Yeast protocol (00:00:50 method: 3 cycles of 10s shaking at 6000 RPM with 10s pauses).
Chill tubes on ice for 1 minute.
Repeat the PreCellys and chill cycle 5 more times (6 cycles total). Thaw samples before each PreCellys run to avoid frozen pellets.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysed mixture to remove debris.

substeps.instruction: Spin tubes in a tabletop centrifuge at 12000 x g for 1 minute 30 seconds at room temperature (or 22 °C). Ensure sample is thawed before centrifugation.

steps.title: Remove DNA
steps.instruction: Use a Zymo Spin IIICG column to remove DNA from the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a Zymo Spin IIICG column (Zymo cat no. C1006) on a collection tube.
Spin at 12000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard the Zymo IIICG column and keep the flow-through.

steps.title: RNA Binding and Washing
steps.instruction: Bind RNA to a Spin IIC column and wash to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL of 100% EtOH to the flow-through in the collection tube and mix well by pipetting up and down at least 4 times.
Transfer the mixture to a Zymo Spin IIC column (Zymo cat no. C1011) on a collection tube and spin at 12000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard the flow-through and add 400 µL of DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the column.
Spin at 12000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard the flow-through and spin again at 12000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA into a clean storage tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the Zymo IIC column to a clean, labeled 1.5 mL tube.
Add 30 µL of nuclease-free water to the filter (without touching the filter with the tip) and incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Spin at 12000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature and discard the column.

steps.title: Quality Control and Storage
steps.instruction: Verify RNA concentration and quality before storage.

substeps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration using a microvolume spectrometer (e.g., NanoDrop); expected result is 1000-2000 ng/µL.
Verify quality via fragment analyzer (expect 2 clear ribosomal RNA bands).
Store RNA at -80 °C (optionally in low-binding tubes and low TE buffer for long-term storage).
